description: The pictures of the game's screens: background is the colour behind the GUI (RGB); font_textures are the game's font pages (ARC entry names) the glyphs of texts are cut from, page 0 first; text_font is the plain font of a text drawn from its string (no glyphs recorded); outline, label: the blocks' boxes and their numbers on arranged pictures (RGBA, pixels of the picture as saved); zoom: how many times bigger a picture is saved (whole pixels, no smoothing); fidelity: a pixel differs from an emulator screenshot's when a channel differs by more than changed_threshold, and shift_search is how many pixels each way the comparison looks for the best match.
